thread:
mariam: quick flag from the quarterly access-scan: found multiple high-priv bindings in project-prod-a that look stale. uploading heatmap to /sec/heatmaps/prod-a.png. can we triage ownership before any removals? :eyes:

jon: on it. quick grep shows 5 service accounts and 3 human principals with roles/editor or roles/owner on storage + two principals with cloudkms.admin on critical keys.

deepa: do we still have maintainers mapped for project-prod-a? i thought we cleaned that project last quarter.

mariam: maintainers list is outdated. i dumped the IAM policy and filtered high-priv roles: 
```
gcloud projects get-iam-policy project-prod-a --format=json > /tmp/prod-a-iam.json
jq '.bindings[] | select(.role | test("roles/(owner|editor|cloudkms.admin|cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter)"))' /tmp/prod-a-iam.json\```

ops-bot: [auto] Policy drift detected: 8 high-priv bindings (potentially stale) in project-prod-a. Creating incident INC-20247 and notifying eng-security.

alex_k: heads-up two SAs are from analytics-pipeline (analytics-deprecated@...). we deprecated that pipeline in 2024-11. might be orphaned. i can run a dry-run revoke if we agree.

deepa: please dry-run. also pull audit logs to confirm last usage timestamps before we send any notices. we need evidence for compliance.

jon: pulled logs from bigquery export. last storage access by analytics SA was 2024-09-12; KMS methods last seen 2024-06-03. query i used: 
```
SELECT protopayload_auditlog.authenticationInfo.principalEmail AS principal, TIMESTAMP_SECONDS(timestamp.seconds) AS ts, protopayload.methodName
FROM `redwood-prod.logs.cloudaudit_googleapis_com_activity_*`
WHERE resource.labels.project_id = 'project-prod-a'
  AND protopayload_auditlog.authenticationInfo.principalEmail LIKE '%analytics%'

ORDER BY ts DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

ryan: our stale-access policy flags >90 days as stale. KMS admin unused for ~240 days is high priority. recommend immediate notify + 7-day window.

mariam: agree. for KMS admins follow the KMS deprovision playbook: notify owners with a 7-day reply window, schedule revoke, take pre/post snapshots, and bundle evidence for GRC. deepa can you draft the owner notice? use this template: 
```
Subject: Action required: elevated KMS/admin access detected for %PRINCIPAL% on %RESOURCE%
Body: We observe no recorded activity for 90+ days. Reply within 7 days with justification and primary contact. Absent a response, we will revoke access and record the change in the entitlement map.
```

deepa: drafting and will paste here. quick question: for SAs whose human owner left, do we rotate to a platform-managed SA or hand to platform-oncall?

alex_k: prefer converting to a managed short-lived credential pattern: bind to a platform-managed SA with limited TTL tokens, then update CI/ops. requires infra coordination.

security-bot: [policy-check] Detected non-compliant pattern: service accounts with permanent owner bindings. Recommend ephemeral-binding and KMS key rotation cadence of 180 days.

jon: dry-run revoke command i tested: 
```
gcloud projects remove-iam-policy-binding project-prod-a \ 
  --member='serviceAccount:analytics-deprecated@project-prod-a.iam.gserviceaccount.com' \ 
  --role='roles/storage.objectAdmin' \ 
  --quiet --dry-run
```
Output indicates binding would be removed (binding id: 3) but no state change in dry-run.

deepa: good. agreed steps: 1) collect audit evidence and last-run metadata; 2) send owner notices; 3) start 7-day timer; 4) revoke bindings after timeout and capture post-revoke audit snapshot; 5) update entitlement map + close Jira SEC-2156. i'll create the ticket now.

ops-bot: INC-20247 updated: evidence bundle placeholder created at /sec/incidents/INC-20247/evidence.zip. Notifying #eng-security and #platform channels.

platform-oncall: tagged. if we transition any SAs to platform-managed, platform-oncall will schedule credential rotation and update downstream configs. expect 48-72h work for CI fixes.

mariam: also check cross-project bindings — one SA looked to have editor in project-prod-b too. if it's cross-project, revoke in the leaf project first to avoid breaking shared folder-level grants. jon, can you run a cross-project scan? 
```
for p in project-prod-a project-prod-b; do 
  gcloud projects get-iam-policy $p --format=json | jq '.bindings[] | select(.members[]? | test("analytics-deprecated"))';
done
```

jon: ran scan and confirmed analytics-deprecated@... appears in prod-a and prod-b. recommend removing from prod-a first.

alex_k: i'll coordinate. after revoke we should run a smoke test on the storage paths and KMS decrypt flows. i'll own the canary and post results here within 48h.

security-bot: [audit] Reminder: attach proof-of-revocation (audit log snippets + iam diff) and owner attestations to the GRC evidence package.

deepa: SEC-2156 created, checklist + attachments added, assigned to eng-security with platform-oncall as reviewer. linking SEC-2156 -> INC-20247.

mariam: thanks. final note: add the affected principals to the entitlement matrix so they show in next review; update our RBAC runbook to document ephemeral-binding pattern for KMS admins. recheck thread in 8 days. :calendar:

jon: will collect pre/post logs and paste summaries here after revoke.

alex_k: canary scheduled. will post results. :white_check_mark:
